text:
ellie-marketing: Need a compact launch pack for next Wed webinar. Deliverables: 3 social tiles (square, landscape hero, story), a 3-panel "inference economics" explainer slide, an inbound routing microdiagram (webinar CTA -> LP -> nurture -> SDR), and a one-line header for email. Mobile-first + 16:9 master. Exports: PNG @1x/2x, layered .fig, MP4 for story. Deadline: first drafts in 48h.

priya-design: On it. Two directions: "Metric-first" (sparklines, cost callouts) and "Conceptual" (icons + flow). Any legal footer?

ellie-marketing: Include a tiny footer: "Illustrative; actual costs vary." Use primary lockup on hero, stacked logo on tiles. Tone: concise, engineering-friendly.

marco-motion: I'll produce motion-friendly keyframes and a 6s loop for the story; will keep layers export-ready and provide Lottie fallback.

noah-growth: For routing microdiagram: include UTM example: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_launch_v1 and sample subject lines for nurture. CTA copy: "Watch demo & claim credits".

design-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST: Figma link required. Artboards: 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080. Provide PNG-1x, PNG-2x, MP4, .fig, color tokens, font files, and AA-accessible color variants.

priya-design: Pushing two comps now into Figma (Metric-first + Conceptual). Prioritizing slide + routing diagram first. Sync tomo 10:30am PT.

ellie-marketing: Thanks team! Prioritize explainer slide + routing microdiagram, then tiles.
